title: 第一三四九章 放九重的来历第一三四八章 七杀对四张机
content_zh:
七杀印符构建起来了七层杀伐道则，从金木水火土到风雷。
四张机炸开，亿万犹如雪崩裂出的雪花飞溅，化为无数的完整规则刃芒。
尽管规则杂乱不堪，可是在两人战斗的混沌空间之中，已经有了无数规则。在有了无数规则的空间之中，轰鸣之音不可避免的响起。
两道神通撞击，似乎是亿万大军在厮杀一般，金戈铁马、狂风烈火、风雷席卷……
七层杀伐道则肆意之下，亿万里尽无生机。
再狂暴可怕的杀势，在漫天炸开的四张机刃芒之下，也是无法再进一寸。
七杀印符构建起来的杀伐道则原本就是一往无前，遇谁杀谁。可一旦被阻拦，杀势立即就迟缓下来，跟着七杀印符的七道杀伐道则在四张机的绞杀之下开始碎裂。
刚刚形成的规则空间再次在两人的神通道则撞击中破开，就连远处还在混沌之中的混沌飞星，哪怕有狄九的顶级护阵护住，此刻也在这种道则冲击之下摇晃不息。
随着七杀印符的七道杀伐道则不断碎裂，狄九四张机的无尽杀芒也同样被撕裂迅速减少。
在混沌之中撕开的空间，似乎受不了这种撞击，在各种神通规则碎裂之下发出呜鸣之音。
放九重脸色微变，狄九对规则的理解超过了他，以这样下去，他的七杀印符根本就奈何不了狄九的这满天杀芒。
虽然还有后手，放九重没有继续动手，而是直接退开，落在了混沌飞星的外围。
四张机虽然厉害，却也不能在碾压了七杀印符之后，还束缚住放九重。
狄九看见放九重退后，很显然是没有继续动手的意思，他的神念从岁月长弓和时空长箭上离开。
以放九重这种实力，他的岁月二张机全力出手，三支岁月长箭应该也要不了对方的小命。要不了对方的小命，还平白暴露了自己的杀招。这种事情狄九懒得去做。
两人都停止了动手，神通道则的轰鸣之音依然是连绵不绝，足足过了一炷香时间，四张机的无尽杀芒这才消散，而放九重的七杀印符同样是销声匿迹。
“狄道友，你是我进入混沌以来，见过第二强的人。我们再打下去，也没有什么意义，我倒是……”
放九重的话没有说完，就被丁小叮打断，“那个卖塔的，你刚才不是要我大哥的混沌飞星吗？来抢啊，你这样让我丁小叮很是看不起……”
丁小叮很想看狄九和放九重继续打，没想到放九重不争气，提前偃旗息鼓。
“我闪电也是看不起……”闪电说完后，似乎想起了什么，瞪着丁小叮说道，“小叮，难道你不知道要叫太爷吗？叫什么大哥？”

放九重无语的看着闪电，如果他的兽宠敢在他说话的时候插嘴，他会一巴掌拍个半死，哪怕是七爪神鲲，也不能例外。
见狄九丝毫没有怪罪闪电的意思，放九重只好一抱拳说道，“狄道友，你对混沌了解多少？”
狄九不知道放九重的意思，他只能摇了摇头。
放九重只好继续说道，“浩瀚混沌其实就是大道起源，我们的道都是起源于混沌，混沌最初形成的是混沌世界，然后才形成道则世界……”
content_en:
The Seven Killing Seal builds up seven levels of killing principles, from metal, wood, water, fire, earth to wind and thunder.
The four machines exploded, and billions of snowflakes splashed like an avalanche, turning into countless complete and regular blades.
Although the rules are messy, there are already countless rules in the chaotic space where the two fight. In a space with countless rules, roaring sounds inevitably sound.
The two magical powers collided, as if hundreds of millions of armies were fighting, with gold and iron horses, fierce winds, fire, and wind and thunder sweeping across...
Under the seven-level killing path, there will be no life for billions of miles.
No matter how violent and terrifying the killing force was, it could not advance an inch further under the four machine blades that exploded in the sky.
The killing path constructed by the Seven Killing Seals was originally to go forward indomitably and kill whoever you encounter. But once blocked, the killing momentum immediately slowed down, and the seven killing paths following the Seven Killing Seal began to shatter under the strangulation of the four machines.
The newly formed regular space was once again broken by the collision of the two divine passages. Even the Chaos Flying Star that was still in chaos in the distance, even if it was protected by Di Jiu's top protective formation, was still shaking under the impact of this law.
As the seven killing paths of the Seven Killing Seal continued to fragment, the endless killing light of Di Jiu Si Zhangji was also torn apart and rapidly reduced.
The space torn apart in the chaos seemed to be unable to withstand the impact, and it made a whining sound as various magical rules were shattered.
Fang Jiuzhong's expression changed slightly. Di Jiu's understanding of the rules surpassed him. If this continued, his Seven Kills Seal would not be able to stop Di Jiu's killing glow.
Although he still had a backup plan, Fang Jiuzhong did not continue to attack, but directly retreated and landed on the periphery of the Chaos Flying Star.
Although the four machines are powerful, they cannot restrain Fang Jiuzhong after crushing the Seven Kills Seal Talisman.
When Di Jiu saw Fang Jiuzhong retreating, he obviously had no intention of continuing to take action. His mind left the Long Bow of Time and Long Arrow of Time and Space.
With Fang Jiuzhong's strength, if he uses his two years' weapons at full strength, the three years' arrows should not be able to kill the opponent. He couldn't risk the opponent's life, but he also exposed his killer move for nothing. Di Jiu was too lazy to do this kind of thing.
Both of them stopped moving, and the roaring sound of the divine passage was still continuous. After a full stick of incense, the endless killing light of the four machines dissipated, and the Seven Killing Seal of the ninth level also disappeared.
"Fellow Daoist Di, you are the second strongest person I have seen since I entered Chaos. It would be meaningless for us to continue fighting, but I..."
Before Fang Jiuchong could finish his words, he was interrupted by Ding Xiaoding, "That tower seller, didn't you just want my brother's Chaos Flying Star? Come and grab it. You make me, Ding Xiaoding, look down on you..."
Ding Xiaoding really wanted to see Di Jiu and Fang Jiuzhong continue to fight, but he didn't expect that Fang Jiuzhong failed to live up to his expectations and stopped early.
"I, Lightning, also look down on..." After Lightning finished speaking, he seemed to remember something and glared at Ding Xiaoding and said, "Xiaoding, don't you know you want to call me Grandpa? What do you call me Big Brother?"
Fang Jiuzhong looked at Lightning speechlessly. If his pet dared to interrupt when he was talking, he would slap him half to death, even the seven-clawed god Kun.
Seeing that Di Jiu had no intention of blaming Lightning, Fang Jiuzhong could only hold his fists and said, "Fellow Daoist Di, how much do you know about chaos?"
Di Jiu didn't know what releasing Jiuzhong meant, so he could only shake his head.
Fang Jiuzhong had no choice but to continue, "The vast chaos is actually the origin of the Dao. Our Dao all originates from chaos. Chaos first formed the world of chaos, and then formed the world of Dao..."
